skills.description_zh: Simplify, clean up, or refactor existing code in any language (JS/TS, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C#, C/C++, PHP, SQL, Bash…) while preserving behavior and public APIs. Use whenever the user asks to simplify, tidy, clean up, refactor, de-nest, deduplicate, remove dead code, modernize syntax (const/let, ===, ??, streams, async/await, for..of), rewrite a function more concisely, polish recently written code, fix code smells (god class, feature envy, primitive obsession), or "make this cleaner" — including 简化代码, 精简代码, 重构, 整理代码, 代码整洁, 去除重复代码, 减少嵌套, 代码坏味道, 这段代码太乱了; read-only simplification assessments too. Not for performance tuning, bug fixes, new features, porting between languages, lint config, writing tests, security review, or prose (性能优化、修 bug、新功能、代码翻译、写单测、文章精简).
skills.name: simplify-code

skills.description: Download videos and extract original post captions, audio transcripts, and metadata from video platform links. Use when the user provides Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat Channels, Xiaohongshu, or YouTube links and asks to save the original video, capture the post text/caption, transcribe the spoken in-video script/copy, archive source material, or prepare video material for downstream analysis or skill creation. Douyin prefers browser-observed media URLs and page transcripts, with H5 and anonymous yt-dlp fallbacks; Bilibili, YouTube, and Xiaohongshu are implemented through yt-dlp; WeChat Channels is not implemented yet and should currently be handled via the WeChat mini program kg百宝箱.
skills.description_zh: 支持抖音、小红书、B站和 YouTube 视频下载、发布文案提取、音频及逐字稿生成。抖音优先使用宿主浏览器观察到的媒体直链与 curl，失败回退 H5 和匿名 yt-dlp，默认不读取浏览器 Cookie。优先导入有效页面字幕，否则使用音频 ASR。支持 whisper.cpp、openai-whisper 和 SiliconFlow；微信视频号暂不支持直接下载。
skills.name: video-downloader-enhanced
